title: Hieronym: Leveraging Hierarchical Multi-Source Information for Function Renaming in Stripped Binary
abstract: arXiv:2609.12457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Function renaming in stripped binaries can substantially assist reverse engineers by improving code readability, yet it is a challenging task. The difficulty stems from the need to accurately capture function semantics from low-level binary code across diverse instruction sets, architectures, and compiler optimizations, and to express these semantics in concise, human-readable names. Existing approaches either inadequately capture comprehensive function semantics or exhibit limited generalization to previously unseen binaries. In this paper, we present Hieronym, a generative large language model (LLM)-based framework for stripped binary function renaming. Hieronym adopts a hierarchical summarization-driven domain adaptation strategy and integrates multi-source information, including global binary context, local calling context, and intrinsic function semantics, to enhance the LLM's understanding of binary code. translated_title: Hieronym：利用分层多源信息进行剥离二进制文件中的函数重命名
translated_abstract: 在剥离符号的二进制文件中进行函数重命名可以显著帮助逆向工程师提高代码可读性，但这是一项具有挑战性的任务。其难度在于需要从跨不同指令集、架构和编译器优化的低级二进制代码中准确捕获函数语义，并以简洁、人类可读的名称表达这些语义。现有方法要么不能充分捕获全面的函数语义，要么对之前未见过的二进制文件泛化能力有限。在本文中，我们提出了Hieronym，一个基于生成式大语言模型（LLM）的剥离二进制函数重命名框架。Hieronym采用分层摘要驱动的领域自适应策略，并整合多源信息，包括全局二进制上下文、局部调用上下文和函数内在语义，以增强大语言模型对二进制代码的理解。为了实现系统性评估...
tldr: 提出Hieronym框架，通过分层摘要驱动的领域自适应策略，整合全局二进制上下文、局部调用上下文和函数内在语义等多源信息，利用大语言模型实现剥离二进制文件中的函数重命名。
en_tdlr: Hieronym is an LLM-based framework for function renaming in stripped binaries that employs hierarchical summarization-driven domain adaptation and integrates multi-source information, including global binary context, local calling context, and intrinsic function semantics.
